briefing: NASDAQ +1.3% and S&P 500 +0.6% mark a mild risk-on day, but cash is just $389.29 — below the $500 deployment threshold — and none of the top-scoring candidates show a volume surge alongside their RSI/MACD/SMA signals, so full four-signal confirmation is missing. Holding all 7 positions and skipping new buys until either more cash accumulates or a stronger, fully-confirmed setup appears.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder means keeping cash on hand rather than investing every dollar immediately. Even on a positive market day, it can be smart to wait if your cash balance is too small to build a meaningful position or if your best candidates don't fully confirm your buy criteria — patience preserves optionality for better setups later.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指保留現金而非立即全數投入市場。即使在市場向好的日子，如果現金餘額太少不足以建立有意義的倉位，或候選股票未完全符合買入條件，耐心等待仍是明智之舉——這樣可以保留資金彈性，留待更好的入市時機。

market_education.summary_en: Markets edged higher today with the NASDAQ outpacing the S&P 500, consistent with a broad risk-on tone in tech and growth names. No major single catalyst stands out from the data available today. Breadth in the momentum screener remains healthy, with many names showing bullish MACD crossovers.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走高，納斯達克指數升幅領先標普500指數，反映科技及成長股帶動下的風險偏好情緒。目前沒有明顯的單一重大消息面催化劑。動能篩選器中多隻股票出現MACD黃金交叉，市場廣度良好。
